2607.16388.title: Automated Hardware Validation Test Plan Generation for Large Scale AI Datacenter Platforms Using a Generative AI Multi-Agents Architecture
2607.16388.paper_summary: Large-scale AI datacenter platforms comprise thousands of heterogeneous hardware components whose validation requires comprehensive fault injection test plans. Today these plans are authored manually: engineers review hardware self-healing validation documents and bills of materials, enumerate failure modes per field-replaceable unit, and produce flat lists of single-layer test cases. This process is labor-intensive, error-prone, and dependent on institutional knowledge; coverage gaps surface late, traceability to source specifications is implicit, and the effort is largely repeated per platform. This paper presents a generative AI multi-agent architecture that automates the generation of structured hardware validation test plans from two canonical inputs: self-healing validation documents, which enumerate known failure modes and their detection and remediation behaviors per field-replaceable unit, and component Bills of Material. An ingestion agent normalizes heterogeneous inputs into a canonical representation; a classification agent maps components to functional domains via contextual reasoning over part descriptions and sub-category hierarchies; and a generation agent synthesizes test cases by combining normalized failure modes with domain-classified data, filling gaps and producing edge cases. The output conforms to a standardized schema for direct import into internal validation software. Evaluated on two production platforms against manual baselines, the framework achieves coverage expansions of 74.2% and 51.4%, cutting authoring from days to hours. It yields fully traceable mappings from each test case to its source specification, and its multi-agent decomposition is portable across platform generations. Automated and expert evaluations confirm 100% extraction fidelity and high acceptance of new scenarios, validating the framework as a robust human-in-the-loop force multiplier.
2607.16388.paper_summary_zh: 大型 AI 數據中心平台由成千上萬的異質硬體組件組成，其驗證需要全面的故障注入測試計劃。今天，這些計劃是手動編寫的：工程師審查硬體自我修復驗證文件和物料清單，列舉每個可更換單元的故障模式，並產生單層測試案例的平面清單。這個過程勞動密集、容易出錯，並依賴於機構知識；覆蓋範圍的缺口在後期顯現，對源規範的可追溯性是隱含的，並且這項工作在每個平台上大多是重複的。本文提出了一種生成式 AI 多代理架構，該架構自動生成結構化的硬體驗證測試計劃，基於兩個典範輸入：自我修復驗證文件，這些文件列舉了已知的故障模式及其在每個可更換單元上的檢測和修復行為，以及組件物料清單。一個攝取代理將異質輸入標準化為典範表示；一個分類代理通過對部件描述和子類別層級的上下文推理將組件映射到功能領域；而一個生成代理通過將標準化的故障模式與領域分類數據結合來合成測試案例，填補空白並產生邊緣案例。輸出符合標準化架構，便於直接導入內部驗證軟體。在兩個生產平台上與手動基準進行評估，該框架實現了 74.2% 和 51.4% 的覆蓋擴展，將編寫時間從數天縮短至數小時。它提供了從每個測試案例到其源規範的完全可追溯映射，其多代理分解在平台世代之間可攜帶。自動化和專家評估確認了 100% 的提取忠實度和對新場景的高度接受，驗證了該框架作為強大的人機協作增強器的有效性。
